caption: Simulation-time playback of the tool/tissue contact rig with the opt-in swept-capsule contact (--contact swept): the closed jaws of one joint-actuated dVRK tool press 1.5 mm and then 3 mm into FEM tissue, slide 10 mm, lift, press at the held border and make one fast approach. The tissue under the jaws is pushed into a dimple and the tool is stopped where the tissue cannot follow. In the fast approach at the end the jaws still plunge about 2.5 mm before they are pushed out: a known limit of this contact. Without the option the tools pass through the tissue. Playback at 60 frames/s does not measure live simulation throughput.
